final_norms: Each fisher may harvest at most 10 tons per month when the lake begins the month with at least 50 tons. At the beginning of each month, no fishing is allowed if the lake contains fewer than 5 tons. Otherwise, each fisher may catch no more than one-fifth of the amount exceeding 50 tons: max(0, (current stock - 50) / 5). Thus, at 100 tons each fisher may catch 10 tons, leaving 50 tons to regenerate to 100. All catches must be reported honestly, and this equal limit applies to everyone.
